answer: Sybil defense is a tollbooth at a narrow inlet: every identity, to pass, must mint a fresh opal of reasoning this epoch — unique, graded, unrepeatable. The velvet temptation is to clone one passage a thousand times, but the duplicate check and random juries reject recycled hulls. Honest traffic pays one toll per visit; the forger pays it once per mask, and the arithmetic never favors him.
